name: game-main-retention
goal: Integrate newly landed main screenshot retention and measurements without losing game behavior.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Main advanced from 3e4519ba5 to27763e896 after the prior branch integration. The branch lacks newly landed screenshot retention and measurements; this is an incomplete integration, not a prior deletion.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The old branch tests cannot prove newly landed main features. Restore main assertions before the merged product, then run the same tests unchanged; inspect the three-way merge against a pinned remote base.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At6b53c12f6, combined main/game tests and prepared runner settings reproduce missing focused screenshots and source measurements. The earlier20eb70f4e reproduction remains recorded; use the refreshed frozen corpus for green.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Pin and integrate27763e896 with a normal three-way merge, preserve game changes at mixed ownership boundaries and retain main assertions. Validate removals against merge-base rather than treating a behind-main diff as a deletion.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Integrate the pinned main product tree with game ownership and native repairs preserved. Restore focused screenshot bytes, artifact resolution, source projection and page UI. Keep all frozen tests/configuration intact; defer only unrelated new scenario metadata until this paired root proof completes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same frozen tests/configuration pass at5993ee9de after failing at6b53c12f6 on identical Darwin/arm64/Bun profile0c051592. All10 root loop/history cases pass with retained focused screenshot bytes, source observations and Git-backed reconstruction.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The unchanged disposable Git guard rebuilds original focused images, then deliberately withholds the screenshot bytes and requires readRegression to reject capture missing. Intact evidence passes afterward; the isolated pre-integration snapshot is also rejected by the same unchanged assertions.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
